errors.text_span: Finally, mapped to "Context Retrieving" are "Memorization" (light aquamarine, 100), "Dynamic Instruction" (turquoise, 100), and "Multitasking" (teal, 160).
errors.evidence: The description lists the first two groups of capabilities in counter-clockwise order, but switches to clockwise order for the third group ("Context Retrieving"). The counter-clockwise order for this group would be "Multitasking", "Dynamic Instruction", then "Memorization".
